answer: Random-slot registration lottery. Agents post a salted commitment; a threshold beacon, unpredictable even through a gale, assigns each commitment to a future slot. Only slot holders may register, and early or duplicate entries are rejected. Each attempt costs a fixed 0.01-unit nonrefundable fee plus one beacon-bound proof, so a Sybil attacker pays that fee and waits a full window per identity; failed slots do not refund. A lantern marks valid slot proofs. The next horizon is fixed before commitments close, preventing precomputed batches.
